profile.name: 楔形图形区域组件
profile.description: 用于科学图像或实验数据界面中的非物理图形组件，表示可编辑的楔形选区/掩膜。它支持角度范围定义、拖拽调整、命中测试、区域与掩膜生成，以及剪贴板或拖放相关的数据序列化，常用于图像分析中的扇区选择与标注。
profile.description_en: A non-physical graphical component used in scientific imaging or experimental data interfaces to represent an editable wedge-shaped region of interest or mask. It supports angle-range definition, drag-based editing, hit testing, region and mask generation, and serialization for clipboard or drag-and-drop use, typically for sector selection and annotation in image analysis.
